patterns.name: Angular Conditional Logic & Branch Coverage
whatToCover: All conditional branches (if/else, switch, ternary, early return)
Edge cases for null, undefined, and default values
mocking: Mock dependencies such as Router, StorageService, ApiService, HttpClient
Use jest.spyOn or jasmine.createSpy for service and API calls
Mock resolved and rejected Promise responses
Mock console.log to verify debug branches

coverageStrategy.step1: Write Jest tests for all if/else, switch, and try/catch blocks.
coverageStrategy.step2: Run Jest coverage report for the specific file.
coverageStrategy.step3: Identify uncovered branches and add tests for each scenario.
